description: Search paid x402 APIs listed in Coinbase's CDP Bazaar by keyword (e.g. 'weather', 'solana token price'), optionally for one payment network and a maximum price: each result's URL, name, description, HTTP method, price per call in USD (for USDC offers), network, payTo address and its paid calls over the last 30 days. Listings are written by their sellers and aren't checked by Toolbooth. Fails (and is not charged) if the Bazaar doesn't answer. Costs $0.002 USDC per call.

maxUsdPrice.description: Only APIs costing at most this many USD per call

network.description: Payment network: base, solana, polygon, arbitrum, ethereum, optimism, or a CAIP-2 id

query.description: What the API should do, e.g. 'weather forecast' or 'web search'

name: x402_discover
title: x402 API discovery
